routes.unobserved_reason: The second-factor code screen renders only mid-sign-in, between a correct password and a verified code. Signed out it redirects to /sign-in; with the saved aal2 operator session it redirects to /. Reaching it needs a fresh password sign-in, and the operator password was not available. Signing out to force the state was forbidden, because it would destroy the session this guide was written from.

The authenticator setup screen renders only for an operator with no second factor attached yet. The one operator account already has one enrolled, so the state is unreachable; signed out it redirects to /sign-in and with the saved session it redirects to /.
